method: Non-overlapping calendar-year seven-day windows over the entire stored 2019–2024 copy history against independent REDMAR. Scores: lag minutes, paired hours, residual RMS meters. A control needs the CLI-style day coverage and at least 72 paired hours at zero and the tested lag. Short/empty windows are not passes. Screening considers at least 20% residual improvement; flags conservatively include surrounding months, not inferred correction epochs. Input receipts are in copy-clock.json, independent-clock.json and copy-controls.json.
